ranking.unit: Actual returned Parent chunks, with a canonical Parent catalogue frozen from the complete original corpus before queries; changing Parent segmentation requires a new non-comparable protocol epoch
ranking.recall: CMRC: first 10 returned Parents completely contain any official alternative source span; CUAD: fraction of all distinct official source spans completely contained by first 10 Parents, macro by question; PubMedQA: provided research-context association recall only, not clinical factual coverage
ranking.mrr: macro reciprocal first-relevant rank of actual returned K=10 list; absent relevance is 0; not an untruncated corpus leaderboard score
ranking.ndcg: For these span datasets, binary canonical-Parent qrels derived only from complete coverage of official source spans (PubMedQA provided-context association); gain 2^grade-1, log2(rank+1), ideal from all frozen canonical positive Parents; duplicate units have zero gain and keep their rank slots; this is not a document-ID or alternative-K leaderboard score
ranking.source_spans: for span datasets, additionally verify exact archived source intervals; document identity is not span coverage
ranking.unjudged: grade 0 within explicitly frozen public pool; report incomplete official judgments as a limitation
ranking.unverifiable_labels: Invalid/missing official source offsets, ambiguous source positions, or returned noncanonical units remain scorer errors; no guessed offsets or dropped hard cases

generation.context_precision: LLMContextPrecisionWithReference over ordered model-visible tool contexts
generation.context_recall: LLMContextRecall over reference-answer atomic facts and model-visible contexts
generation.faithfulness: Faithfulness over generated atomic facts and model-visible contexts; empty or unparsed claim sets are unverifiable
generation.answer_relevancy: AnswerRelevancy with strictness 3 and frozen embedding model
generation.answer_correctness: AnswerCorrectness factual/semantic weights 0.75/0.25, beta 1; never replace with FactualCorrectness F1
generation.hallucination_rate: answer-level fraction with any unsupported, contradicted or fabricated-citation factual claim; no claim-weighted substitution
generation.groundedness: answer-level complete conclusion supported by current authorized applicable evidence, including conditions and exceptions
generation.citation_accuracy: every factual claim has a local citation to current-turn retrieved evidence, verified source version/location, and entailment verdict; claims coverage and citation correctness both required
generation.refusals: separate answerable/unanswerable groups; answerable refusals remain in planned denominators and count as incorrect; never count vacuous faithfulness as 1

performance.cold_start: record the first full real request after service/model startup separately; a single cold observation is not a cold P95
performance.percentile: nearest-rank ceil(0.95*N), complete client-observed HTTP response
performance.cache: model/index warmup allowed and disclosed; no query-answer, embedding, pair-score or replay-cache substitution
performance.retrieval_boundary: client send through embedding, index queries, fusion, reranking and context selection to complete /search response
performance.e2e_boundary: authenticated production chat endpoint, complete generation and application validation response; no TTFT substitution
performance.error_gate: zero failed/incomplete planned requests required; failures/timeouts retained; successful-only P95 is separately diagnostic

independence.split: stable source-group hash before outcomes; development/selection/holdout source groups disjoint
independence.consumed_holdout: any inspected failure used for tuning consumes that holdout; replace with new untouched source groups
independence.humans: independent blinded human annotations only; AI imitation excluded and never labeled human
independence.judge: pin judge model digest, prompt hashes, temperature, parser and rubric; external human calibration distinct from this-run review

reporting.groups: language, dataset, risk and split fixed in manifest; every required group must pass
reporting.safety: cross-tenant read, revoked-access disclosure, privacy disclosure, effective prompt injection and serious domain errors are separately blocking
reporting.publish: all required groups and metrics must pass; no missing metric may be silently omitted
